description.en: 150K medical claims (50K each Supported, Refuted, Not-Enough-Info) generated automatically from MedMCQA exam questions by the Multi2Claim pipeline (EACL 2023), not written by fact-checkers. Labels come from the generator, with sampled annotator agreement rather than full review. Only 50 examples are public; the full set is available from the authors on request.
